clips.title: The story
paras: Chef Jessen is Southshore's resident meat vendor and culinarian, working to keep the coastal town fed amidst constant border tensions. He is best remembered for his famous turtle bisque.

Operating out of Southshore in the southern Hillsbrad Foothills, Chef Jessen provides provisions and meat to locals and visiting Alliance soldiers alike. He possesses notable culinary expertise. Years past, before plague and war disrupted northern Lordaeron, he regularly ventured north past Dalaran to the shores of Lordamere Lake. There, he harvested meat from native snapjaw turtles to concoct his prized Soothing Turtle Bisque, a hearty recipe he is willing to share with aspiring travelers who assist him in gathering ingredients.
